title: Pentagalloylglucose disrupts the PALB2-BRCA2 interaction and potentiates tumor sensitivity to PARP inhibitor and radiotherapy.
authors: Zeng, Jie; Han, Jichang; Liu, Zhaorui; Yu, Meng; Li, Hao; Yu, Jianzhong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子对接发现PGG小分子破坏PALB2-BRCA2蛋白-蛋白互作，虽涉及DNA修复但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA界面建模，故评5分。
abstract: DNA damage repair plays a vital role in maintaining the genomic integrity of cells and has been exploited therapeutically in the treatment of cancer. We have previously demonstrated that the upregulation of CXorf67 in posterior fossa type A ependymoma sensitizes tumor cells to PARP inhibitors by suppressing the PALB2-BRCA2 protein-protein interaction (PPI). Here, we performed structure-based virtual screening of  approximately 2 million small molecular entities followed by NanoBiT-based screening, and determined that pentagalloylglucose (PGG) disrupts the PALB2-BRCA2 PPI. Structure-based molecular docking and in vitro binding affinity assays revealed that PGG occupies a well-defined binding groove in the tips of the fourth and fifth blades of the PALB2 WD40 domain. PGG reduces BRCA2 recruitment to DNA damage sites and inhibits the formation of RAD51 foci, suppressing homologous recombination repair. PGG also inhibits proliferation and survival in several cancer cell lines, including breast cancer and medulloblastoma cells, and suppresses the in vivo growth of tumor xenografts. Thus, PGG is a specific inhibitor of the PALB2-BRCA2 PPI, which has potential value in cancer treatment to sensitize tumors to PARP inhibitors and radiotherapy.
abstract_zh: DNA损伤修复在维持细胞基因组完整性中发挥关键作用，并已被用于癌症的治疗性干预。我们此前已证明，后颅窝A型室管膜瘤中CXorf67的上调通过抑制PALB2-BRCA2蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）使肿瘤细胞对PARP抑制剂敏感。在本研究中，我们进行了基于结构的虚拟筛选，涵盖约200万个小分子实体，随后通过基于NanoBiT的筛选，确定五没食子酰葡萄糖（PGG）能够破坏PALB2-BRCA2 PPI。基于结构的分子对接和体外结合亲和力测定显示，PGG占据PALB2 WD40结构域第四和第五叶片尖端的一个明确结合沟槽。PGG减少BRCA2向DNA损伤位点的募集，并抑制RAD51焦点形成，从而抑制同源重组修复。PGG还抑制多种癌细胞系（包括乳腺癌和髓母细胞瘤细胞）的增殖和存活，并抑制肿瘤异种移植物的体内生长。因此，PGG是PALB2-BRCA2 PPI的特异性抑制剂，在癌症治疗中具有使肿瘤对PARP抑制剂和放疗增敏的潜在价值。
